thread:
incident-bot: 🚨 INCIDENT detected: billing-metering.token-drift in prod (eu1). anomaly score 0.82. Pager routed to @ops-oncall and billing team.

ops-oncall: ack — I'm on it, joining the bridge now. grabbing logs + checkpoints.

prashant: quick snapshot: emitter-q (eu1, partition 5) shows shadow counts ~3-7% higher than primary since 02:10 UTC. delta concentrated in short messages (chat completions).

maya: confirming: Kafka consumer lag on metering-ingest eu1.p5 ~120k msgs. ingestion workers restart last night correlated. backlog looks stuck; ingestion timestamp skewed.

jamie: can we suppress automated overage flags while we triage? runbook has suppress toggle `suppress_charge_flags`.

ops-oncall: good call. do we have the safe-scoped toggle? I'll apply to eu region only.

tom: applied suppress_charge_flags -> true for eu1. :thumbsup: command log: ```curl -X POST https://ops.internal/api/toggles/suppress_charge_flags -d '{"region":"eu1","enable":true}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'```

prashant: thanks. starting a targeted backfill on partition 5 to reingest and reconcile shadow -> primary counts. kicked job `metering-backfill --partition=5 --since=2026-03-20T02:00:00Z` ETA ~25m.

siva: kicked an ad-hoc recon query to find top impacted accounts: ```SELECT account_id, SUM(shadow_tokens) AS shadow_tokens, SUM(primary_tokens) AS primary_tokens, (SUM(shadow_tokens)-SUM(primary_tokens))*1.0/SUM(primary_tokens) AS pct_diff FROM metering.reconciled WHERE ts >= '2026-03-20T02:00:00Z' GROUP BY account_id ORDER BY pct_diff DESC LIMIT 50;``` planning to export top 20 for CS.

billing-bot: Notifying CS for top-20 impacted accounts with advisory template: "Transient billing flags observed; charges under review; no automatic billing adjustments yet." Draft created: https://wiki.internal/redwood/billing/incident-templates#token-drift (CS pinged).

maya: observed customer-visible overage emails for ~12 accounts (small set). We should hold on refunds until recon completes. Ops: please capture the message IDs + timestamps for follow-up.

jamie: after backfill completes we need to run end-to-end replay: `/scripts/billing/replay --window=3h --verify --report /tmp/recon-1797777001.csv` then run the regression checks.

ops-oncall: bridge: https://meet.link/incident-1797777001 — CS and oncall joined. drafting external comms if needed.

prashant: backfill progress: 40% (10m in). re-checking consumer group offsets; there was a flaky circuit in ingest-worker that caused paused commits. I patched the worker to skip malformed records.

tom: monitoring dashboards: tokens_emitted_by_region eu1 spike converging as backfill progresses. alert thresholds suppressed for overflagging only. other monitoring still active.

billing-bot: queued an internal audit ticket RB-5432 to reconcile billing ledgers once we have replay output. tagging finance and accounting.

ops-oncall: next update in 10m or when backfill finishes. if backfill completes and recon looks good we'll un-suppress flags and lift the incident.

incident-bot: STATUS: mitigation in progress. suppress_charge_flags=true (eu1). backfill started (partition 5). ETA 25m. Impact: ~12 customer overage triggers, no confirmed incorrect charges yet.

prashant: note for postmortem: need stricter consumer commit visibility + alert for consumer-lag > 50k. documenting now.

maya: CS message draft ready, asking PO for approval.

ops-oncall: updating incident channel with timeline and runbook links. thanks all.
